description: Single sign-on, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users and about 1,400 contractors
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division administers its systems through SYS-G1; without sign-in no engineer can operate the HCP, the RMM, or the CDE, although customer workloads keep running
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system (HCP, fleet, CDE, RMM), tested quarterly; hardware keys held in two regional safes
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; the Managed IT legacy identity tenant federates through it (scenario gap 1)

description: 24x7 SOC: SIEM, SOAR, EDR, AI alert triage, threat intelligence, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks keep running during an outage (FedRAMP 1-hour Initial Incident Report for PAIN-3 to PAIN-5, DFARS 72 hours, bank notices as soon as possible, Form 8-K Item 1.05); blind spots let attackers move between divisions
manual_workaround: Analysts work from native cloud and EDR consoles; retainer firm tooling; AI triage can be switched off and alerts worked manually
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and SOAR vendor; EDR vendor; third-party model service; forensic retainer
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 260 SOC analysts in three sites; division liaisons
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division relies on the SOC for detection and the facts behind every notice

business_process: Group landing zone, keys, log archive, and backup vault
description: Corporate accounts on SL-1, central log archive, key management, guardrails, and the immutable backup vault at external provider X
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Division workloads (CDE, RMM, CUI enclave) run in landing-zone accounts; the backup vault is the last line of defense against ransomware
manual_workaround: Restore from the vault at external provider X using its separate backup identity
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payment Processing CDE accounts, the RMM, SYS-M2, and corporate workloads

description: Group General Counsel office runs the notification matrix: regulators, agencies, banks, sponsor banks, card networks, clients, and investors
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks across all three divisions (P08); the matrix and contact lists must be reachable when email is not
manual_workaround: Printed binder and contact lists in each division command center; outside counsel can send notices
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs SOC facts (BP-G02) and division contact lists (bank-designated contacts, agency contacts, BAA and client terms)

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and all divisions

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; termination events drive access removal in SYS-G1
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; manual termination tickets to the identity team
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination feed to SYS-G1 for all divisions

business_process: Corporate collaboration and IT service management
description: Email, chat, documents, and the IT service desk for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Staff coordination; change tickets for every division
manual_workaround: Out-of-band messaging on managed phones; phone bridges
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions; incident coordination assumes this may be compromised and moves out of band

business_process: Commercial compute, storage, and network data plane
description: Running customer virtual machines, volumes, object storage, managed databases, and Kubernetes clusters in regions R1 to R5
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 99.99% multi-zone SLA; about 38,000 customers including about 260 banking organizations (bank notice threshold of 4 hours) and the Payment Processing CDE; about $27.9 million revenue per day
manual_workaround: Customers fail over across zones and regions using their own designs; zone evacuation runbooks
dependent_people_or_facilities: Data center operations; 15 commercial data centers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: The CDE, the RMM, and SYS-M2 run on SL-1, so a regional outage also hits Payment Processing and Managed IT

business_process: Hosting control plane and customer portal (HCP)
description: Console, public API, customer identity and access, provisioning, metering capture, support tooling, run-command, and partner-operator access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers cannot create, scale, or repair workloads; running workloads continue (P02 availability Moderate); 99.9% console and API SLA
manual_workaround: Running workloads unaffected; API retries; emergency changes through break-glass fleet access
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Managed IT partner-operator access and Payment Processing deployments depend on it

description: Data plane and control plane of the G1 region for 27 federal agencies and about 140 DIB companies
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Agency missions; FedRAMP availability reporting (CDS-CSO-AVR) and incident reporting (IEC); DFARS 252.204-7012(b)(2)(ii)(D) duties to DIB customers
manual_workaround: Agencies fail over between G1-A and G1-B; no failover to commercial regions by design

business_process: Authoritative DNS, content delivery, and DDoS protection
description: Edge services for customers and for the group itself (portals, APIs, payment gateways)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every customer-facing and payment-facing endpoint resolves through SYS-H4; DNS failure looks like a full outage
manual_workaround: Secondary DNS at an unaffiliated provider for group zones; static failover records
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payment gateways and merchant portals, Managed IT client portals

business_process: Fleet automation and software supply chain
description: CI/CD, artifact signing, image builds, and the guest-agent update service that reaches customer VMs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Security fixes cannot ship while it is down, but integrity matters more than speed: a tampered pipeline can reach every customer VM

shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SOC facts drive every notice; bank-designated contacts on file for 70% of bank customers

description: Usage capture, rating, and invoicing for SL-1 and G1

manual_workaround: Freeze non-urgent changes; on-site technicians use local consoles under break-glass
dependent_people_or_facilities: Data center technicians in 17 data centers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None
